|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Han's Medal]] (its only version). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. It is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A same-words slip on a Players Committee release sheet that reprints a card image is part of that card image's version, not a version of its own (Bill, 17 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 5 March 2023<ref name="ht-32e1135">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual21-Light/large/hansmedal.gif</code> as published 5 March 2023: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/32e11351311a33497ffb43a1612b36c3ae669e88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/hansmedal.gif holotable commit 32e1135] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on Han or a Wookiee.
